claims.scope: Accountant backing/surplus reads and settlement revert until cleanup.

preconditions.text: The Vault has an Accountant configured.; There is no active registration for the target BLP slot before the supply call.
preconditions.derivation: Program conjunction of selected report preconditions.

safety.text: notifyVaultSupply must be called only after verifying the supplied slot is readable and active.
safety.derivation: Program synthesis from the selected intent and logical pattern.

effects.text: Accountant backing/surplus reads and settlement revert until cleanup.
effects.derivation: Program-generated direct negation witness for the selected safety pattern.

effect_coverage.reason: Program-generated exact coverage for selected direct impact.

assumptions: The Accountant is configured on HyperCore as described in the environment.
The target BLP slot is the 0x811 supplied slot.

limitations: The impact is encoded as a potential Boolean outcome because the report provides no numeric magnitudes or ranges for the reverts.
The safety relation is narrowed to the report-stated ordering requirement that notifyVaultSupply occur only after verifying the slot is readable and active.
Whether the operator is authorized or permissionless is not encoded because the report does not state it.
